business_problem: The company is continuously expanding its modular product portfolio for B&G operators of different sizes, scales, and needs. OpenBet aimed to create a geolocation solution that was transparent and flexible to better meet operator needs.
solution_summary: Betting and gaming (B&G) operators worldwide use geolocation to comply with regulatory requirements, verify that players are in stipulated gaming jurisdictions while placing bets, and check for fraudulent activity. The company used building blocks provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS) to create OpenBet Locator, a cost-effective geolocation solution that operators can use to meet compliance requirements and detect fraudulent activity. “Combining our excitement and willingness to enter this space, our capability to add new products, and the scale and capability of AWS across the board, it felt like a really good fit,” says Don Jaques, vice president of corporate strategy at OpenBet.

solution_components.name: Amazon Location Service
solution_components.role: Adds geospatial lookups and verification to customer-facing applications.

solution_components.name: AWS Marketplace
solution_components.role: Distributes packaged software offerings to AWS customers.

data_flow: OpenBet Locator provides operators flexibility to study data points, learn more about their end customers, and use the data for other use cases.
business_outcome: “This is just the tip of the iceberg of what we can do by using the scale of what AWS does,” says Depoortere. “Building an efficient SaaS product on AWS services means OpenBet can bring something very cost-effective and flexible to the market,” says Jaques.
metrics: The solution also optimizes the number of location checks per customer, resulting in up to 75 percent lower costs for operators and better battery life and application responsiveness for players.
architecture_clues: For example, OpenBet Locator can help operators detect instances of one device or mobile application being used to place bets for multiple people in different regions, as well as device spoofing, different types of hacking, or the usage of virtual private networks.
evidence_quotes: OpenBet is a content, technology, and services provider for the B&G industry, delivering world-class solutions to operators globally.
Its customers include top-tier gaming operators and market leaders in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada.
The company is continuously expanding its modular product portfolio for B&G operators of different sizes, scales, and needs.
It recently introduced a regulatory technology vertical following the acquisition of Neccton, a provider of player protection software.

To build on its existing capabilities in responsible gaming, OpenBet aspired to create a geolocation solution that would help operators meet compliance requirements established by country and state regulators and provide new ways to connect with and market to customers.
